title: Angelica archangelica tincture for medicinal use
intro: Angelica archangelica tincture is a concentrated herbal preparation made by soaking the dried roots and stems of the angelica plant in alcohol. This tincture is valued in herbalism for its purported ability to support digestion, relieve respiratory congestion, and promote overall vitality. It is often used to treat conditions such as indigestion, coughs, and colds due to its expectorant and carminative properties. The preparation is also believed to have calming effects and may be used to support the nervous system. In traditional herbal medicine, it is sometimes employed as a tonic to boost energy and improve circulation.
